description: Single derived observations used as volatility grid centres when the local FRED graph CSVs (.cache/fred/, gitignored) are absent, e.g. on the deployed app. Values are the series' published closes on the stated dates (percent points), looked up on the date each note needs. No price series are stored.
source: FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv); VIXCLS and RVXCLS are CBOE indices via FRED.
